info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Protocols
info.description:
Network protocol configuration from Cisco-IOS-XE-native model.

**Includes:** bfd, bfd-template, ntp, cdp, mpls, l2vpn, l2vpn-config, l3vpn, lacp, ppp, multilink, udld, mvrp, ptp, clns, frame-relay, xconnect

**Key Features:**
- Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD)
- Network Time Protocol (NTP)
- Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP)
- MPLS and L2VPN
- Link Aggregation (LACP)
- PPP and Multilink
- UDLD, MVRP, PTP

**Base Path:** `/data/Cisco-IOS-XE-native:native/`

**Related:** See 'Router' for routing protocols

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Protocols.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Protocols.yang)

get.description: Retrieve bFD configuration from the RESTCONF interface

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.
